title: regex_guard step config
description: Deprecated model-free pattern guard that rejects, warns or redacts on a list of named Java regular expressions.

input_field.description: Context key to scan; prompt (or unset) means the request itself, scanned per scope, and any other key is scanned alone.

scope.description: Turns inspected when the guard reads the request: last_user, user_turns, or conversation (every user, assistant and tool turn, system turns excluded); refused alongside any input_field other than prompt.

on_empty.description: What to do when there is no text to inspect: reject halts with the rendered message and skip passes to the next step; defaults to reject for the reject action and skip for warn and redact.

patterns.description: Named Java regular expressions evaluated in order; an empty list skips the step.

name.description: Free-form label used as the [NAME] replacement and in the entity_type fields.

pattern.description: Java Pattern source; blank patterns are ignored in redact mode.

action.description: What happens on a match: reject halts the pipeline, warn flags and continues, redact masks the matched spans; the codec falls back to reject for unknown values.

redact_with_entity_type.description: Redact only: replace spans with [NAME] (upper-cased) instead of [REDACTED].

output_field.description: Redact only: context key receiving the redacted text (the original text when nothing matched); defaults to <step id>.output.

message.description: Jinja template rendered on reject and returned as the failure message.
